consumer: Character::craft calls select_crafting_recipe (crafting_gui.cpp), which PRESENTS a full-screen interactive recipe browse/filter/pick menu through the engine's own active input loop and returns the chosen recipe (nullptr on cancel).
scope: the interactive crafting menu itself — recipe browse/filter/selection plus batch-size entry driven through the engine's active input loop; not a read of any item snapshot
decisive_source: src/crafting_gui.cpp::select_crafting_recipe — its body runs a full-screen interactive menu answered via the engine's input loop and returns the picked recipe; src/crafting.cpp::Character::craft consumes that returned recipe to start the craft.
divergence: Backend, lacking the menu loop, silently returns a recipe the player never chose (defaults to the first craftable recipe, or to nullptr/cancel) and a craft begins or is dropped with no real menu interaction — a recipe selected that no input-loop selection ever produced.
